extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare a NIH-format biographical sketch (PHS 398-style) for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors, following the specified sections and a five-page limit. Includes education/training, personal statement, positions/honors, contributions, and research support entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply to each individual's biosketch; keep the entire biosketch to five pages maximum. Follow the listed section ordering and include required fields for each person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name / eRA COMMONS USER NAME / Position Title
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME: [e.g., Kakeeto, Stella]  eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):  POSITION TITLE: [e.g., Senior Grants Administrator, College of Health Sciences, Makerere University]
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include legal/full name, eRA Commons user name if available, and a concise position title reflecting current role. These are header/identifying fields on the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (table)
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)  Columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE (if applicable); Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List training entries beginning with the baccalaureate, then subsequent degrees and relevant postdoctoral or residency training. Use the table columns shown (institution/location, degree, completion date in MM/YYYY, field). Add or delete rows as necessary to represent the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Personal Statement (narrative describing the individual's background and relevance to the project).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize the individual's experience, expertise, and specific relevance to the proposed project or role (examples in the document show linking past experience to how the person will contribute and benefit—e.g., training/mentorship plans, administrative roles). Keep focused and concise within the overall page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Positions and Honors — list of Positions and Employment and Honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of positions/employment (with dates) and notable honors/awards. Include leadership roles and relevant committee or board memberships that demonstrate qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Research Administration
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contribution to Research Administration — narrative of research-administration–related studies, activities, system or policy development, training, capacity-building, and other contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe substantive contributions to research administration (e.g., development of grants offices, manuals, SOPs, training activities, committee work), with examples and impacts (such as number of trainings, policies developed, institutional improvements). Use concrete examples to show scope and relevance to grant management capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance — list ongoing and completed research support with role and dates (e.g., R01 HD090981 (NICHD) … Role: Grants Administration Officer; dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide current (ongoing) and completed research support entries including award identifiers, project title/brief description, role on the project, and dates. Distinguish ongoing vs completed support and include only relevant information within page limit.
